photo.alt: Aerial view of Bern, ringed by a bend of the Aare

facts: About 146,000 people (2024), the fifth most populous Swiss city
542 m up, surrounded by the Aare river
worth_knowing: Officially the "federal city" and de facto capital. Legend says the city was named for the first animal its founder met on a hunt, a bear. Its old town became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1983.
